stem: A technician sees marginal necrosis on several plants. What belongs in the initial record?
choices: Objective symptom location/distribution plus stage and available pH, EC, irrigation and root-zone context
A claim that genetics caused it
rationale: Objective symptom location/distribution plus stage and available pH, EC, irrigation and root-zone context. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
